Title: TC-001 Launch reaches main menu
Preconditions:
Java 21 installed; Unciv.jar present

Requirement: REQ-01
Test data: java 21.0.7
Steps:
1. Open a terminal in the install folder
2. Run java -jar Unciv.jar
3. Wait until a window appears
Expected: Main menu is visible. No crash dialog. Version string readable.

Title: TC-002 New Game screen opens
Preconditions:
Main menu visible

Requirement: REQ-02
Test data: default
Steps:
1. Click New game
2. Look for civ / difficulty / map controls
Expected: New Game screen shows civilization, difficulty, and map options.

Title: TC-003 Start a tiny single-player game
Preconditions:
New Game screen

Requirement: REQ-02
Test data: tiny map 1–2 AI
Steps:
1. Pick any playable civ
2. Set smallest map the UI offers
3. Set fewest AI opponents the UI offers
4. Difficulty Prince or equivalent
5. Start game
Expected: Game leaves New Game and shows the map. No freeze longer than map-gen spinner.

Title: TC-004 First turn controls exist
Preconditions:
Game started TC-003

Requirement: REQ-03
Test data:
Steps:
1. Look at the map
2. Click a unit if one is selected by default
3. Find Next Turn
Expected: At least one unit or settler can be selected. Next Turn is visible and enabled or explains why not.

Title: TC-005 New Game with no mods
Preconditions:
Mods not installed or disabled

Requirement: REQ-15
Test data: no mods
Steps:
1. From main menu open the mods / content list if present
2. Confirm none enabled
3. Start another tiny game
Expected: Game starts on the base ruleset. No missing-mod dialog.

Title: TC-006 Found a city with the settler
Preconditions:
First turn; settler selected

Requirement: REQ-04
Test data: settler
Steps:
1. Move settler onto a flat land tile if needed
2. Use Found city
3. Accept the name if prompted
Expected: A city appears on that tile. City screen or city banner is available.

Title: TC-007 Queue a production item
Preconditions:
City founded

Requirement: REQ-05
Test data: first buildable
Steps:
1. Open the city
2. Open production
3. Choose a worker or monument or the first listed build
4. Confirm it sits in the queue
Expected: Selected item is the current production. Turns-remaining or progress is shown.

Title: TC-008 Change production before completion
Preconditions:
Item in queue from TC-007

Requirement: REQ-05
Test data: second item
Steps:
1. Open production again
2. Pick a different item
3. Close and reopen the city
Expected: Queue shows the new item. Old item is not still building unless the UI says it was kept.

Title: TC-009 Open tech picker and select a tech
Preconditions:
First turns

Requirement: REQ-06
Test data: first tech
Steps:
1. Open research / tech picker
2. Select the first available tech
3. Close picker
4. Reopen
Expected: Selected tech is highlighted or listed as current research.

Title: TC-010 Research selection survives Next Turn
Preconditions:
Tech selected TC-009

Requirement: REQ-06
Test data:
Steps:
1. Next Turn once or twice
2. Open tech picker
Expected: Same tech still selected unless it completed.

Title: TC-011 Move a unit one tile
Preconditions:
Unit with movement remaining

Requirement: REQ-07
Test data: one tile
Steps:
1. Select a unit
2. Click an adjacent legal tile
3. Watch movement points
Expected: Unit occupies the new tile. Movement points drop.

Title: TC-012 Unit cannot enter illegal tile
Preconditions:
Unit selected

Requirement: REQ-07
Test data: illegal tile
Steps:
1. Try to move onto a tile the UI treats as illegal (deep water for a land unit if shown)
2. Observe
Expected: Move is refused or not offered. Unit stays put. No crash.

Title: TC-013 Attack an adjacent hostile if present
Preconditions:
Military unit next to barbarian or AI unit

Requirement: REQ-08
Test data: first contact
Steps:
1. Select own military unit
2. Attack the hostile
3. Read the combat result
Expected: HP of one side changes or a unit dies. No freeze.

Title: TC-014 Civilopedia opens and closes
Preconditions:
Main menu or in-game menu

Requirement: REQ-14
Test data: any entry
Steps:
1. Open Civilopedia
2. Open one entry
3. Close back to the game
Expected: Entry text is visible. Closing returns to the previous screen. UI stays responsive.

Title: TC-015 Resize window mid-game
Preconditions:
In-game map visible

Requirement: REQ-13
Test data: two sizes
Steps:
1. Drag the window corner
2. Make it smaller then larger
3. Click a unit
Expected: Map redraws. Buttons remain clickable. No permanent black region.

Title: TC-016 Change an option and read it back
Preconditions:
Main menu Options

Requirement: REQ-12
Test data: one toggle
Steps:
1. Open Options
2. Change one display or autosave control
3. Close Options
4. Reopen Options
Expected: The control still shows the new value.

Title: TC-017 Option survives restart
Preconditions:
TC-016 done

Requirement: REQ-12
Test data: same toggle
Steps:
1. Quit Unciv
2. java -jar Unciv.jar
3. Open the same option
Expected: Value from TC-016 is still there.

Title: TC-018 Save a named game
Preconditions:
City founded; turn > 1

Requirement: REQ-09
Test data: QA-pack-2026-09-24
Steps:
1. Open Save
2. Type a unique name
3. Confirm
4. Open the save list
Expected: The name appears in the list. No error toast.

Title: TC-019 Load the named save
Preconditions:
TC-018 saved; optionally quit first

Requirement: REQ-10
Test data: same save
Steps:
1. Load QA-pack-2026-09-24
2. Check turn number and city existence
Expected: Turn and city match the save moment. Map is the same seed/layout.

Title: TC-020 Continue after quit
Preconditions:
Saved game exists

Requirement: REQ-11
Test data: last game
Steps:
1. Quit to OS
2. Launch
3. Continue or Load last
Expected: Same match resumes. Not a new map.

Title: TC-021 Smallest map still playable
Preconditions:
New Game

Requirement: REQ-02
Test data: min settings
Steps:
1. Set every size/opponent control to the minimum the UI allows
2. Start
3. Found a city
Expected: Game starts. Map has room for the city. No crash during gen.

Title: TC-022 Start blocked when a required choice is empty
Preconditions:
New Game

Requirement: REQ-02
Test data: incomplete form
Steps:
1. Clear or leave unset any required field the UI lets you clear
2. Click Start
Expected: Start does nothing or shows a prompt. No crash. No half-generated map.

Title: TC-023 Save name rejected or trimmed if empty
Preconditions:
Save dialog open

Requirement: REQ-09
Test data: empty name
Steps:
1. Clear the name field
2. Confirm
Expected: Save is refused or a default name is applied. No crash. No zero-byte file as the only slot.

Title: TC-024 Owned roads not charged as neutral — regression
Preconditions:
Road on owned tile if reachable in timebox

Requirement: REQ-08
Test data: owned road
Steps:
1. Have a road on a tile you own
2. Move a unit along it
3. Compare movement cost to a neutral road if one exists
Expected: Movement cost matches owned-road rules. See BUG-005 (4.22.0 fix).
